item.title: Mbah, Akpabio Commend Senator Ngwu Over ₦250m Bursaries, Scholarships For Students
item.description: Governor Mbah and Senate President Akpabio praise Senator Ngwu for ₦250 million education support to Enugu West students.

item.title: Tinubu To Armed Forces: Intensify Efforts To Protect Civilians Across Nigeria
item.description: President Tinubu orders armed forces to strengthen civilian protection and rescue abducted victims after terrorist attack in Borno.

item.title: Crisis In Global Anglican Church Deepens As Conservative Bloc Forms New Council In Abuja
item.description: Conservative Anglican leaders announce creation of Global Anglican Council in Abuja, rejecting authority of traditional Anglican Communion structures.

item.title: At Crusade In Ahoada, Kumuyi Urges Political Leaders to Prioritise Nigerians’ Welfare
item.description: Deeper Life General Superintendent William Kumuyi urges political leaders to put Nigerians first and enact people-centred policies.

item.title: Tinubu Commends Emeka Offor Foundation Over Nationwide Medical Book Distribution
item.description: Tinubu praises Emeka Offor Foundation for donating medical books to strengthen healthcare education across Nigerian tertiary institutions.

item.title: Rivers: ADC Demands Arrest Of Perpetrators Over Ubima Secretariat Arson
item.description: ADC condemns burning of its Ubima secretariat in Rivers State, urges security agencies to investigate and arrest those behind the attack.

item.title: Nigeria Cannot Immediately Evacuate Citizens As Iran War Escalates
item.description: Federal Government says evacuation of Nigerians in Middle East delayed due to security risks and widespread airspace closures.

item.title: Over 300 Abducted As Terrorists Attack Borno Community
item.description: Terrorists abduct more than 300 people, including women and children, during attack on Ngoshe community in Borno.

item.title: Tinubu: We’ll Defeat Terrorism And Other Threats To Nigeria’s Stability
item.description: Tinubu assures Nigerians terrorism will be defeated, sympathises with Borno over Ngoshe attack as army reaffirms loyalty.

item.title: Asake Gifts Parents Luxury SUVs, Expands Collection With Brabus G800
item.description: Afrobeats star Asake surprises his parents with luxury SUVs while adding a high performance Brabus G800 to his own collection.
